description: This file defines metrics and functions related to audit event monitoring within the Kubernetes API server, including counters for events, errors, policy levels, and rejected requests, as well as functions to observe and handle audit plugin errors.

methods.name: ObserveEvent
methods.description: Updates the event counter metric for a generated audit event.

methods.name: ObservePolicyLevel
methods.description: Updates the level counter metric for an audit event with a specific policy level.

methods.name: HandlePluginError
methods.description: Handles errors in audit plugins, increments error counters, and logs detailed error messages.
